title: Swiss Chard ‘Canary Yellow’ - 2x Plug Plants - Hardy Variety
description:
2x Swiss Chard ‘Canary Yellow’ Plug PlantsBright yellow stems, dark green crinkled leaves. Mild, tender, high in vitamins. Easy, vigorous, and fast.Key details:

  Maturity: ~55 days
 

  Plant height: 16–20 inches
 

  Light: Full sun
 

  Spacing: 8–12 inches between plants; 18–24 inches between rows
 

  Planting depth (reference): 1/2 inch (for seed; plugs plant to crown level)
 

  Germination (for reference): 7–14 days (seed)
 

Harvest/maintenance:

  Begin harvesting outer leaves at ~8 inches for continuous picking
 

  Cut back in late summer to extend fall production
 

  Frost tolerant; harvest continues after first frost
 

Note: Chard is typically direct-sown; plug plants provide a head start and quick establishment.
